mapper.select: SELECT a.ANNOTATION_ID ,a.TITLE ,a.CONTENTS ,a.CREATED_DATE ,a.USER_ID ,a.LABEL_TYPE FROM ANNOTATION a WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{user_id} AND TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND CONTENTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{contents},'%') AND LABEL_TYPE = #{label_type} ORDER BY a.ANNOTATION_ID DESC LIMIT ${page_num}, ${page_size}
SELECT a.ANNOTATION_ID ,a.TITLE ,a.CONTENTS ,a.CREATED_DATE ,a.USER_ID ,CONVERT(a.DATA USING utf8) AS DATA ,a.LABEL_TYPE FROM ANNOTATION a WHERE 1=1 AND a.ANNOTATION_ID = #{annotation_id}
SELECT a.ANNOTATION_ID ,a.TITLE ,a.CONTENTS ,a.CREATED_DATE ,a.USER_ID ,a.LABEL_TYPE FROM ANNOTATION a WHERE 1=1 AND d.ANNOTATION_ID = #{annotation_id}

SELECT COUNT(a.ANNOTATION_ID) AS TOTAL_COUNT FROM ANNOTATION a WHERE 1=1 AND USER_ID = #{user_id} AND TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{title},'%') AND CONTENTS LIKE CONCAT('%',#{contents},'%') ORDER BY a.ANNOTATION_ID DESC
SELECT a.ANNOTATION_ID ,a.TITLE FROM ANNOTATION a WHERE TITLE = #{title}
